sharedRules.name: Improved Ordnance
sharedRules.description: Choose one heavy firepower weapon each turn. It can either re-roll one to hit dice or add 1 to its Blast (X) special rule. You must state which before rolling to hit.

sharedRules.name: Trainer
sharedRules.description: Nominate one unit within 12" of Major Loren Chard at the start of the game. That unit improves its Melee and Accuracy value by 1. In addition, all of the unit’s weapons have the Tag special rule, as other units in the force try to follow Chard’s lead.
